candidates.change_summary: Replace `acc.balance += msg.value` with `acc.balance -= msg.value` to incorrectly update the balance.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value` with `acc.balance = msg.value` to overwrite the balance instead of adding.
Delete `acc.balance += msg.value` so the balance is never incremented.
Replace `require(((acc.balance + msg.value) >= acc.balance))` with `require(msg.value > 0)` to change the overflow guard condition.
Delete the require guard so balance can overflow.
Replace `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp` with `acc.unlockTime = 0` to always set unlockTime to 0.
Replace `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp` with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime` to ignore the block.timestamp floor.
Replace `LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Put")` with `LogFile.AddMessage(address(0),msg.value,"Put")` to log a wrong sender.
Remove the check that block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime so that Collect succeeds regardless of unlock time.
Remove the requirement that acc.balance >= MinSum so that Collect succeeds even when balance is below MinSum.
Delete the balance deduction so that Collect sends ether without reducing the stored balance, allowing repeated extraction.
Remove acc.balance >= _am check so that Collect can overdraw the balance and send more ether than deposited.
Change the condition from AND to OR so that Collect succeeds when any one condition holds, bypassing all guard combinations.
